There was some problem like the one that you described, but updates solved it. 
  zypper up
should bring your system up to date. 

Though, some information about your system would be useful to prevent tapping 
in the dark. Can you post output of:
  lspci 
and 
  hwinfo --gfxcard

For compiz I'm not sure, I stopped to use it, but you can see in YaST Software 
Management is it installed. 

-- 
Regards, Rajko.
